name: Dezhou United Petroleum Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Dezhou United Petroleum Technology Co.,Ltd. (DUPT) is a Chinese enterprise that specializes in providing a wide array of equipment, specialized tools, accessories, and technical services for the oil drilling and production sector. DUPT's comprehensive inventory includes various drilling implements such as down-hole motors, non-magnetic components, hydraulic thrusters, insulating joints, and other joint products. Its offerings also extend to essential drilling machinery, encompassing power section and downhole motor test benches, hydraulic breaking units, and drilling pumps. For the extraction of oil and gas, the company supplies sophisticated solutions like profile control pump and injection systems, Christmas tree assemblies, and snubbing products. Additionally, DUPT manufactures vital well-control apparatus, notably casing heads. Beyond its domestic operations, the company also engages in the international export of its products. Founded in 1961, Dezhou United Petroleum Technology Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Dezhou, China.
